editorial: Today, the focus in the software world is on hiring agents and data visualization tools that automate recruitment processes. In particular, the new resources published by Apple on container architecture constitute a basic reference for developers on system isolation and performance optimization.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open source agent-based system that turns AI-powered coding assistants into a comprehensive video production studio. This Python-based platform allows automating video production processes with 12 different workflows and more than 500 agent skills.

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: The daily stock analysis system developed by ZhuLinsen processes multi-source market data and current news using large language models (LLM). The system offers regular stock market analysis at zero cost, thanks to its decision support panel and automatic notification features.

items.title: apple/container
items.summary: Developed by Apple, Container allows creating and running Linux containers using lightweight virtual machines on macOS. This tool, written in Swift language, offers performance optimized for Apple silicon architecture.

items.title: interviewstreet/hiring-agent
items.summary: Hiring-agent is an artificial intelligence agent (AI agent) designed to evaluate and score resumes. This tool, developed with Python language, aims to automate candidate screening processes in recruitment processes.

items.title: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
items.summary: Using artificial intelligence coding agents, this template allows you to copy the structure of any website with a single command. Developed with TypeScript language, the tool automates content and design transfer in web development processes.

items.title: revfactory/harness
items.summary: Harness is a meta-skill framework that designs domain-focused artificial intelligence agent teams and automatically generates the specialized skills these teams need. The system aims to optimize workflows by defining agent structures that will perform complex tasks.

items.title: flutter/flutter
items.summary: Developed by Google, Flutter allows you to quickly create user interfaces for mobile, web and desktop platforms using a single code base. This open source framework, based on the Dart programming language, is widely preferred for developing high-performance and visually rich applications.

items.title: andreknieriem/headunit-revived
items.summary: The headunit-revived project provides an application that allows viewing the Android Auto interface on different screens. This software, developed in Kotlin language, provides an alternative display solution for in-vehicle infotainment systems.

items.title: stablyai/orca
items.summary: Developed by Stablyai, Orca offers an agent development environment that allows managing multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously. Using their subscription, users can run various coding agents on both desktop and mobile platforms.

items.title: google-labs-code/design.md
items.summary: Developed by Google Labs, DESIGN.md provides a structured format specification for passing visual credentials to coding agents. This standard ensures that design systems are understood consistently and permanently by artificial intelligence agents.

items.title: Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube
items.summary: Zapret-discord-youtube is a tool that aims to provide access to restricted platforms by encrypting network traffic or using packet fragmentation methods. It was developed specifically to overcome access barriers to services such as Discord and YouTube.

items.title: kunchenguid/no-mistakes
items.summary: Developed with the Go language, no-mistakes is a command line tool designed to prevent software developers from submitting faulty code (git push). By running in the local development environment, it provides a layer of security that prevents unwanted changes from being pushed into the code base.

items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.summary: Developed by NousResearch, Hermes Agent is an artificial intelligence agent (AI agent) that improves over time by learning through user interactions. This Python-based system supports autonomous workflows with personalized task management and continuous learning capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI unveils its first custom chip, built by Broadcom
items.summary: OpenAI announced Jalapeno, the first custom-made chip developed in collaboration with Broadcom. This hardware is designed to speed up inference processes and reduce the operational costs of artificial intelligence models.

items.title: RubyLLM: A Ruby framework for all major AI providers
items.summary: RubyLLM offers a framework that allows applications developed with the Ruby programming language to access different artificial intelligence providers. This tool standardizes the process by which developers integrate large language models into their Ruby-based projects.

items.title: Krea 2: SOTA open-weights 12B image model
items.summary: Krea 2 is an open-weighted model with 12 billion parameters that offers high performance in image creation processes. Optimized to improve visual production quality, this model aims to set a new standard in the field of image synthesis.

items.title: Anthropic says Alibaba illicitly extracted Claude AI model capabilities
items.summary: Anthropic alleges that Alibaba copied the capabilities of the Claude AI model without permission. The company argues that model weights and architectural features were extracted using unauthorized methods.

items.title: A Practical Guide to SSH Tunnels: Local and Remote Port Forwarding
items.summary: Secure Shell (SSH) tunnels are used to securely transmit network traffic using local and remote port forwarding methods. This guide explains with practical examples the technical processes that provide secure data access between different servers by encrypting network traffic.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model designed for text generation tasks. The model, which has reached a wide user base on the HuggingFace platform, offers text generation capabilities in natural language processing processes.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Developed by Baidu, Unlimited-OCR is an image-to-text model that processes visual texts and produces text output. The system aims to automate the process of converting data from complex documents into digital format.

items.title: yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF
items.summary: Gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF is an optimized language model with text-generation capabilities. Thanks to the GGUF format, it supports code writing and content creation processes on local devices with low hardware requirements.

items.title: yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-agentic-fable5-composer2.5-v2-3.5x-tau2-GGUF
items.summary: This Gemma-4-12B based model is a text generation model developed using customized agent capabilities and composition techniques. This structure, presented in GGUF format, aims to perform more efficient inference operations on local hardware.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M is a language model that performs text generation with extended context window support. It is presented in quantized GGUF format, which allows operation on low-resource devices.

glossary.explanation: Autonomous software structure that can make decisions on its own and plan the necessary steps to achieve the goal.
A series of interconnected automatic stages through which data is processed.
A special ability or tool that an artificial intelligence software uses to perform a specific task.
An advanced artificial intelligence model that understands, summarizes or produces new content by learning human language.
Packages that contain all the files required for a software to run and ensure that it works the same on every computer.
Apple's own processor architecture specifically designed for high performance and low energy consumption in its devices.
A digital assistant that interacts with its environment and makes its own decisions to carry out the commands it receives from the user.
Artificial intelligence-based assistants for software developers who write code, find errors and improve projects.
The functional capabilities that a software or system has to do a specific job.
A high-level skill that enables learning new skills or using existing skills more efficiently.
The visual display and control area that allows the user to interact with a device or software.
A set of ready-made structures and rules used to speed up work when developing software.
Digital display panel in vehicles that offers both navigation and entertainment features such as music.
Custom software development environment used to create, test and manage artificial intelligence assistants.
A standard library of colors, fonts, and components used to ensure consistency in the design of an application.
The process of dividing the data sent over the Internet into smaller pieces according to the carrying capacity of the network.
